checked_profile.summary: Unsecured borrowing for eligible PNC checking customers.
checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Application requirement
facts.text: PNC states that applicants must have an eligible PNC personal checking account and be enrolled in PNC Online Banking.

facts.label: Amounts and terms
facts.text: Published loan amounts are $5,000–$35,000. The table offers terms from 12 to 60 months, with rates depending on the amount and term.

facts.label: Published APR table
facts.text: The August 27, 2026 table spans 6.99%–25.29% APR across different amount and term combinations and includes a 0.25% automatic-payment discount. This is not the range for every loan size or term.

facts.label: Fees and collateral
facts.text: PNC lists no application fee, origination fee or prepayment penalty, and no collateral requirement.
